description: List what an actor knows, oldest first. Each entry has a kind: expertise and process entries are listed by title in every run and the actor reads one when the task calls for it; reference and account entries are found by search. Check here before add_actor_knowledge to avoid duplicates; pass an entry id to remove_actor_knowledge.
name: list_actor_knowledge

id.description: Knowledge entry UUID, the knowledge_id remove_actor_knowledge takes.

kind.description: expertise: a skill or standard used in every run. process: steps it follows in every run. reference: facts looked up when relevant. account: test account details.

title: List actor knowledge
